text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Woke up at 7:00 AM. 28 minutes to prepare—right on schedule.
Currently, there are no deviations from the itinerary.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Today's schedule will be a bit tight, but...
I will carry it out flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Man, that totally lived up to the hype! "The Gunpowder Pâtissière" was so gritty, underground, and awesome!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In particular, the part where the protagonist's feelings
were metaphorically expressed through the visuals was truly captivating.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Depicting the emotion of fear through captivating imagery...
I felt it had something in common with classic German cinema.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oho! Then I wonder if the slightly horror-ish direction in this movie was influenced by that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, that's a fresh perspective I never had, totally.
What do you say? Let's grab some tea and chat again sometime~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Do you understand? And not just with granulated sugar—keep in mind that even a single gram can affect the finished product.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood! I'll make sure not to add too many haskap berries...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Asking Flash-san was definitely the right move!
I think our cheesecake overflowing with Tomakomai goodness will turn out delicious today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once it's done, please taste-test it with me!
Oh, right, let's call Rickey and the others too!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That sounds wonderful.
I look forward to seeing the finished result.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash-saaan! How was Falco today?
Did I sparkle a whole bunch?☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You were shining brighter than ever.
Especially in the third song, your rhythm in both singing and dancing
was flawless... I could see the result of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!! Flash-san always gives credit
where credit's due, doesn't she? ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, are you sure? Having you help me
clean up the stage and everything...!”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't worry about it.
It's just my way of thanking you for showing me something so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "『Mit freundlichen Grüßen』 means 'Sincerely yours.' If you have a closer relationship, 『Alles Gute!』 should suffice."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Alles Gute, and... okay, all done writing!
All right, sending it now. There!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! Amazing, amazing!
I was actually able to reply to my grandmother in Germany in German...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, Flash-san. I'd like to thank you,
so could I invite you out for sweets sometime?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's quite alright.
Let's reschedule for another day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's head back to the academy soon.
We still have our final schedule ahead of us.
Today is a day off. However—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... phew.
...Running practice, complete.
choice_data_list: Well then, let's take a quick break!

text_block_list.text:
Per her request, we're training.
Putting in the final push for her next race.
Apparently, before coming here, she planned out every minute of her schedule to spend time with her friends.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You're not packing your schedule too tight, are you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine. In fact, precisely because it's a precious day off,
I was hoping to spend it with a clear plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...They made time for me and said they wanted to meet.
I want to answer those friends' feelings.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Because every single one is an important schedule.
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we continue training?!
Did you get a nice break today?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Just as planned.
"She must have a packed schedule after this." Thinking that, I told her I would try to wrap up our time together early, to which she—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Just in case you weren't aware,
I wanted to make sure I explained it properly."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To me, this time spent working hard
alongside you, Trainer, is also—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's one of the important items on the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...The schedule proceeded exactly as planned.
Smoothly, without deviating by even a single second.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Each and every one was deeply meaningful and... fufu.
It turned into a truly relaxing time."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...So, yes.
I believe it turned into a truly wonderful day."
